name: echo-pipeline
description: The ticket 8.2 data-flow proof: a three-step echo chain where every value moves between steps through `${{ ... }}` template expressions — run params into the first step (including a whole-object param preserved as JSON), nested-path references and string interpolation in the second, and a multi-hop third step that reaches two hops upstream, passes a whole output object through by reference, and exercises the full restricted function set (get with a lenient path, default, toJson, truncate). Echo steps output exactly their rendered input, so each step's recorded output is a direct probe of what rendering resolved.
